name: Freezer dinner planner
pitch: Plan a month of dinners using ingredients from a chest freezer inventory list.
instructions: Start by reading the freezer inventory file. List each item and its quantity. Group items by type: meat, vegetables, prepared meals. For each week, pick a theme: one week for stews, one week for casseroles, one week for quick stir-fries. Match items from the list to those themes. If an item has no clear theme, note it for a 'use first' day. When a day's meals are chosen, write a simple menu for that day. Repeat until four weekly menus are built. At the end, show a table with the four weekly menus and the full ingredient list. If the inventory file is empty or missing, say so and ask if they want to start a new list.

examples.does: read the inventory list and build a four-week menu

readme:
# freezer dinner planner
Plan a month of dinners using ingredients from a chest freezer inventory list.

What it does: reads your inventory, groups items, creates four weekly menus, and shows a table.
What it needs: a text file with your freezer items.
What it will not do: it cannot cook or buy groceries.
